name: ⬆️ GET TO THE TOP! ⬆️ [NEW SHOP!]
desc:
--NEW UPDATE --

-Shop added with some awesome items to purchase with points. Buy items to give you more of an advantage over other players who are trying to Get to the top!

-Points are now saved
-Items bought from the shop will be saved

NEXT UPDATE:
More Badges and Different Obstacles to climb so stay tuned.

Wecome to my new game 'Get To The Top' where the objective is, well... Get to the top!

Play through randomly generated Towers and try to beat your friends to the top first. 
Place Blocks, Trusses, Planks to help you on your way up if you get stuck, But use them sparingly, You only have a limited quantity per round.
Use Mines to stop other players from reaching the top before you. You will receive points when someone hits your mine.

~Game Created by FatPapsGamesLtd
